description:
Configuration for pre-encoding audio files to latents.

This configuration controls the pre-encoding process that converts audio files
to latent representations using stable-audio-tools pretrained models.

batch_pattern.description: Regex pattern to group files into batches
batch_pattern.title: Batch Pattern

batch_size.description: Batch size for processing audio files
batch_size.title: Batch Size

create_output_dir.description: Whether to create output directory if it doesn't exist
create_output_dir.title: Create Output Dir

file_pattern.description: File pattern to match audio files
file_pattern.title: File Pattern

hf_token.description: HuggingFace token for accessing gated models
hf_token.title: Hf Token

input_dir.description: Directory containing audio files to encode
input_dir.title: Input Dir

log_failures.description: Whether to log failed files to failures.log
log_failures.title: Log Failures

model_name.description: HuggingFace model name for the pretrained audio encoder
model_name.title: Model Name

n_devices.description: Number of GPU devices to use for encoding
n_devices.title: N Devices

output_dir.description: Directory to save encoded latent files
output_dir.title: Output Dir

path_file.description: Path to file containing list of audio files to process
path_file.title: Path File

use_path_file.description: Use a file containing paths instead of directory scanning
use_path_file.title: Use Path File

title: PreEncodeConfig
